About Me

About Cody Arvonen

Hi, I’m Cody Arvonen. I am currently a 3rd-year Electrical & Computer Engineering PhD student at UT Austin researching Wearable Computing under Dr. Edison Thomaz.

Cody with his wife and daughter at his BYU graduation.

Connect on LinkedIn
🎓

Academic Background

I earned my B.S. in Computer Engineering from Brigham Young University and am now pursuing my PhD in ECE at UT Austin. I have practical experience in machine learning, embedded systems, and mobile software development.

🇦🇷

Bilingual Support (English & Spanish)

After studying Spanish in high school and college and living abroad for two years in Argentina, I speak Spanish with professional proficiency. I am glad to conduct tutoring sessions in Spanish or assist bilingual families and international students.

👨‍👩‍👧

Family & Community Focused

My wife and I live in Austin with our 3-year-old daughter and have another child on the way. I aim to be a patient, reliable, and approachable tutor that parents and students can feel comfortable working with.

🎯

Straightforward & Clear Teaching

I focus on core understanding and problem-solving skills without overpromising. I tutor subjects where I have solid hands-on experience and will always be honest if a topic requires a different specialist.
